policy: Empty source and N/A export remain accepted missing-token convention, not gene synonym evidence.
Fetch current official HGNC record for each unique export symbol. Exact source-symbol membership in approved symbol,prev_symbol,alias_symbol is direct current nomenclature support only.
Numeric source literals cannot be synonyms; do not convert them to dates or guess intended symbols.
If no exact source membership, mark unresolved/conflicting; no fuzzy matching or name similarity.
Record HGNC ID,status,date_modified and exact field evidence. Current support is not source-era equivalence or experimental validation.
Never alter corrected export or original genes.
